goal: cancel preview and roll back incomplete geometry changes
positive_oracle: Preview geometry canceled with Escape restores document and no undo entry
negative_oracle: Cancel after partial state or C++ error must not leave orphan preview entity
method: git rev-parse HEAD + git status in the pinned checkout, then bounded file reads with line numbers. Decisions are OM9-owned; no upstream code is copied.

planned_anchors.what_is_missing: a step can be abandoned; OM9 keeps abandonable steps and adds the rule that an abandoned step leaves nothing behind.

implemented_api_before_this_task: session.rs::preview(&self, point) computes the rubber band from the session state WITHOUT mutating anything, and returns Ok(None) when nothing runs
session.rs::cancel() drops the session; the document is only touched at the commit inside accept_world_point
gap_found_by_this_task: Pinned and verified: a preview exists during the command and is gone after Escape (probe: preview_was=true, preview_now=None), the document and the journal are untouched, and a click after the cancel is refused with Missing('active command') — no orphan preview entity can survive, because the preview never becomes an entity until the command commits.
Also pinned: a REFUSAL is not a cancel — a zero-length line keeps the command open with its preview so the user can retry, and the retry commits exactly one entity and one journal entry.
reuse_decision: ADAPT the abandonable step of gui.rs; ADD the rule that a cancel leaves neither entity nor journal entry.
